slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: The roundup reports that Algeria gazetted the National Data Governance Framework, a public tool with a unified mechanism for organising, managing and exchanging data among public institutions; it gives no event date, so the update's published date of 2026-06-23 is used (it covers January and February 2026).
